import {
  boundingRadius,
  MAX_COORD,
  pairPenetration,
  penaltyEdgeNormals,
  penaltyContainerNormals,
  visitContainerProtrusions,
  type PackingConfig,
  type Container,
  type Pose,
} from "@polypack/geometry";
import type { ObjectiveValue } from "./lbfgs";

export interface PenaltyState {
  config: PackingConfig;
  container: Container;
}
export function packState(state: PenaltyState): number[] {
  const { config, container } = state;
  return [
    ...config.pieces.flatMap((p) => (config.N === 0 ? [p.x, p.y] : [p.x, p.y, p.theta])),
    container.cx,
    container.cy,
    container.size,
    ...(config.M === 0 ? [] : [container.phi]),
  ];
}
export function unpackState(template: PackingConfig, x: readonly number[]): PenaltyState {
  const stride = template.N === 0 ? 2 : 3;
  const offset = stride * template.P;
  const phi = template.M === 0 ? 0 : x[offset + 3];
  return {
    config: {
      ...template,
      container_phi: phi,
      pieces: template.pieces.map((_, i) => ({
        x: x[stride * i],
        y: x[stride * i + 1],
        theta: stride === 2 ? 0 : x[stride * i + 2],
      })),
    },
    container: { M: template.M, cx: x[offset], cy: x[offset + 1], size: x[offset + 2], phi },
  };
}

/** A rebuilt grid is safe even for long line-search moves; no Verlet displacement assumption. */
export function nearbyPairs(poses: readonly Pose[], reach: number, stopped: () => boolean): [number, number][] {
  const grid = new Map<number, Map<number, number[]>>();
  const pairs: [number, number][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < poses.length; i++) {
    if (stopped()) return pairs;
    const a = poses[i];
    const ix = Math.floor(a.x / reach);
    const iy = Math.floor(a.y / reach);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(ix) || !Number.isSafeInteger(iy)) {
      // Outside the representable cell lattice, neighbouring integer offsets
      // can collapse to one number. A bounded fallback avoids duplicate pairs.
      const all: [number, number][] = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < poses.length; j++) {
        for (let k = j + 1; k < poses.length; k++) {
          if (stopped()) return all;
          if (Math.hypot(poses[j].x - poses[k].x, poses[j].y - poses[k].y) <= reach) all.push([j, k]);
        }
      }
      return all;
    }
    for (let ox = -1; ox <= 1; ox++) {
      if (stopped()) return pairs;
      const column = grid.get(ix + ox);
      if (!column) continue;
      for (let oy = -1; oy <= 1; oy++) {
        if (stopped()) return pairs;
        for (const j of column.get(iy + oy) ?? []) {
          if (Math.hypot(a.x - poses[j].x, a.y - poses[j].y) <= reach) pairs.push([j, i]);
        }
      }
    }
    let column = grid.get(ix);
    if (!column) {
      column = new Map();
      grid.set(ix, column);
    }
    const cell = column.get(iy);
    if (cell) cell.push(i);
    else column.set(iy, [i]);
  }
  return pairs;
}

export interface PenaltyObjective {
  evaluate(x: readonly number[]): ObjectiveValue;
  updateMultipliers(x: readonly number[]): void;
  violation(x: readonly number[]): number;
}
/** Powell–Hestenes–Rockafellar inequality AL: [max(0,lambda+2wg)^2-lambda^2]/(4w). */
export function createPenaltyObjective(
  template: PackingConfig,
  weight: number,
  multipliers: Map<number, number> | Map<string, number>,
  augmented: boolean,
  stopped: () => boolean = () => false,
  supportOnly = false,
): PenaltyObjective {
  const stride = template.N === 0 ? 2 : 3;
  const offset = stride * template.P;
  const radius = boundingRadius(template.N);
  const pairCount = template.P * template.P;
  const wallCount = template.M === 0 ? template.N || 1 : supportOnly ? template.M : (template.N || 1) * template.M;
  // Older direct callers use vertex-edge string IDs. Translate once at the API
  // boundary; the hot loops and the registered method use only integer IDs.
  const firstKey = multipliers.keys().next().value;
  const legacy = typeof firstKey === "string" || (firstKey === undefined && !supportOnly);
  const lambdas = legacy ? new Map<number, number>() : (multipliers as Map<number, number>);
  if (legacy) {
    for (const [key, lambda] of multipliers as Map<string, number>) {
      const [kind, a, b] = key.split(":");
      lambdas.set(
        kind === "p" ? Number(a) * template.P + Number(b) : pairCount + Number(a) * wallCount + Number(b),
        lambda,
      );
    }
  }
  const scratch = new Float64Array(2 * (template.N + template.M));
  const containerAxes = new Float64Array(3 * template.M);
  let constant = 0;
  if (augmented) {
    for (const lambda of lambdas.values()) constant -= (lambda * lambda) / (4 * weight);
  }
  function pairs(poses: readonly Pose[]): [number, number][] {
    const out = nearbyPairs(poses, 2 * radius, stopped);
    if (augmented && lambdas.size) {
      const seen = new Set(out.map(([i, j]) => i * template.P + j));
      for (const key of lambdas.keys()) {
        if (key >= pairCount || seen.has(key)) continue;
        out.push([Math.floor(key / template.P), key % template.P]);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  const axes = template.N === 0 ? [] : Array.from({ length: template.P }, () => new Float64Array(3 * template.N));
  function visit(
    x: readonly number[],
    add: (
      depth: number,
      i: number,
      px: number,
      py: number,
      pt: number,
      j: number,
      qx: number,
      qy: number,
      qt: number,
      cs: number,
      cp: number,
      index: number,
    ) => void,
  ): void {
    const state = unpackState(template, x);
    if (template.M !== 0) penaltyContainerNormals(template.M, state.container.phi, containerAxes);
    if (template.N !== 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < template.P; i++) penaltyEdgeNormals(template.N, state.config.pieces[i].theta, axes[i]);
    }
    for (const [i, j] of pairs(state.config.pieces)) {
      if (stopped()) return;
      const p = pairPenetration(template.N, state.config.pieces[i], state.config.pieces[j], axes[i], axes[j]);
      add(p.depth, i, p.a.x, p.a.y, p.a.theta, j, p.b.x, p.b.y, p.b.theta, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < template.P; i++) {
      if (stopped()) return;
      visitContainerProtrusions(
        template.N,
        state.config.pieces[i],
        state.container,
        (depth, px, py, pt, cx, cy, cs, cp, index) => add(depth, i, px, py, pt, -1, cx, cy, 0, cs, cp, index),
        supportOnly,
        scratch,
        containerAxes,
      );
    }
  }
  return {
    evaluate(x) {
      const gradient = Array<number>(x.length).fill(0);
      if (!x.every(Number.isFinite) || x[offset + 2] <= 0 || stopped()) return { value: Infinity, gradient };
      // A start in the accepted global range can span at most 2*MAX_COORD
      // relative to its centroid. Guard spatial blow-ups, not finite angles.
      for (let i = 0; i < template.P; i++) {
        if (Math.abs(x[stride * i]) > 2 * MAX_COORD || Math.abs(x[stride * i + 1]) > 2 * MAX_COORD)
          return { value: Infinity, gradient };
      }
      if (Math.abs(x[offset]) > 2 * MAX_COORD || Math.abs(x[offset + 1]) > 2 * MAX_COORD)
        return { value: Infinity, gradient };
      let value = x[offset + 2] + constant;
      gradient[offset + 2] = 1;
      visit(x, (depth, i, px, py, pt, j, qx, qy, qt, cs, cp, index) => {
        const lambda = augmented
          ? (lambdas.get(j >= 0 ? i * template.P + j : pairCount + i * wallCount + index) ?? 0)
          : 0;
        const factor = Math.max(0, lambda + 2 * weight * depth);
        if (factor === 0) return;
        value += (factor * factor) / (4 * weight);
        gradient[stride * i] += factor * px;
        gradient[stride * i + 1] += factor * py;
        if (stride === 3) gradient[stride * i + 2] += factor * pt;
        if (j >= 0) {
          gradient[stride * j] += factor * qx;
          gradient[stride * j + 1] += factor * qy;
          if (stride === 3) gradient[stride * j + 2] += factor * qt;
        } else {
          gradient[offset] += factor * qx;
          gradient[offset + 1] += factor * qy;
          gradient[offset + 2] += factor * cs;
          if (template.M !== 0) gradient[offset + 3] += factor * cp;
        }
      });
      return { value: stopped() ? Infinity : value, gradient };
    },
    updateMultipliers(x) {
      if (!augmented) return;
      visit(x, (depth, i, _px, _py, _pt, j, _qx, _qy, _qt, _cs, _cp, index) => {
        const key = j >= 0 ? i * template.P + j : pairCount + i * wallCount + index;
        const next = Math.max(0, (lambdas.get(key) ?? 0) + 2 * weight * depth);
        if (next > 0 && Number.isFinite(next)) lambdas.set(key, next);
        else lambdas.delete(key);
      });
      if (legacy) {
        const old = multipliers as Map<string, number>;
        old.clear();
        for (const [key, lambda] of lambdas) {
          const id =
            key < pairCount
              ? `p:${Math.floor(key / template.P)}:${key % template.P}`
              : `w:${Math.floor((key - pairCount) / wallCount)}:${(key - pairCount) % wallCount}`;
          old.set(id, lambda);
        }
      }
    },
    violation(x) {
      let maximum = 0;
      visit(x, (depth) => {
        maximum = Math.max(maximum, depth);
      });
      return maximum;
    },
  };
}
